event_name: Document 35 Date 28 April 2019 Time 14:14 2019 AZERBAIJAN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 April 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 33), summoned (document 34) and heard the team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: The front wing of car 7 deflected more than 5mm under a load of 60 N.
offence: Breach of Article 3.9.8 of the FIA Formula One Technical Regulations.
penalty: Disqualified from the results of qualifying.
reason: The stewards reviewed the evidence from the Technical Delegate and heard from the team representatives. The Stewards find that the front wing of car 7 deflected more than 5mm under a load of 60 N, in breach of Article 3.9.8 of the FIA Formula One Technical Regulations.
